name: Gilded Sigil
description: An ornate amber runic ring over a subdued open-work mystic sigil.
notes: All layers use a centered 512 x 512 RGBA canvas. Decorative runes carry no gameplay meaning and the letterless fixed ring expects runtime cardinal glyphs. The bright heading needle dominates the feathered wind pointer.

orientationConventions.ring: Static north-up card. The crowned runic north index is at 12 o'clock.
orientationConventions.headingPointer: The broad bright-gold tip points to 12 o'clock at heading 0. Its boss is centered at (0.5, 0.5); rotate it by pure player world bearing.
orientationConventions.windPointer: The slimmer blue feather-spear tip points to 12 o'clock at wind bearing 0. Its boss is centered at (0.5, 0.5); rotate it by pure wind-toward world bearing.
orientationConventions.lubberMarker: Optional static top accent for the north index. It does not replace the heading pointer.
